title: Show HN: Craftplan – I built my wife a production management tool for her bakery
guide_zh: 为妻子的微型面包房自建 Craftplan，用开源工具管理配方和生产流程。
author: deofoo
excerpt: My wife was planning to open a micro-bakery. We looked at production management software and it was all either expensive or way too generic. The actual workflows for a small-batch manufacturer aren't that complex, so I built one and open-sourced it. Craftplan handles recipes (versioned BOMs with cost rollups), inventory (lot traceability, demand forecasting, allergen tracking), orders, production batch planning, and purchasing. title: Show HN: NanoClaw – "Clawdbot" in 500 lines of TS with Apple container isolation
guide_zh: NanoClaw 用约五百行 TypeScript 核心代码配合 Apple 容器，隔离代理运行。
author: jimminyx
excerpt: I’ve been running Clawdbot for the last couple weeks and have genuinely found it useful but running it scares the crap out of me. OpenClaw has 52+ modules and runs agents with near-unlimited permissions in a single Node process. NanoClaw is ~500 lines of core code, agents run in actual Apple containers with filesystem isolation. Each chat gets its own sandboxed context. This is not a swiss army knife. It’s built to match my exact needs. Fork it and make it yours.

title: Show HN: If you lose your memory, how to regain access to your computer?
guide_zh: 担心脑震荡后忘记密码，作者把秘密分享与加密组合成离线账户恢复工具。
author: eljojo
excerpt: Due to bike-induced concussions, I've been worried for a while about losing my memory and not being able to log back in. I combined shamir secret sharing (hashicorp vault's implementation) with age-encryption, and packaged it using WASM for a neat in-browser offline UX. The idea is that if something happens to me, my friends and family would help me get back access to the data that matters most to me. 5 out of 7 friends need to agree for the vault to unlock.
